speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
text: There will be no other changes to Part 7 of the CTMA.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Singapore has made significant progress against COVID-19 and we have emerged as a more resilient nation.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
text: We now have a high level of hybrid immunity in our population through vaccination and recovery from past infection.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Our COVID-19 situation has been stable over the past months.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
text: We now treat COVID-19 like other endemic infectious diseases, such as influenza and emphasise the need for all of us to keep up to date with vaccinations, to practice good hygiene habits and exercise social responsibility to prevent the spread of infection.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
text: We must not take the current situation as a given or be complacent.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
text: There is still uncertainty as to how COVID-19 will develop globally.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
text: The virus continues to circulate and will continue to mutate.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
text: We cannot rule out the possible emergence of new variants that can cause infection waves and strain our healthcare resources.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
text: The Ministry of Health (MOH) continues to monitor the COVID-19 situation and the evolution of the virus through our international networks and local surveillance to pick up early signals of new variants that could be more transmissible or cause more severe disease.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Should such a variant emerge, we must continue to have the necessary tools to take appropriate prevention and control measures.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
text: We should, therefore, continue to provide in our statutes the ability to implement measures used during the pandemic.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
text: We have been relying on the CTMA during the COVID-19 pandemic.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
text: It was enacted as temporary legislation to tackle the threat of COVID-19.
